channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Iran ceasefire holding for now, Hegseth says, after Iran attacks UAE, ships in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's ceasefire appears to be holding after recent attacks on the UAE and ships in the Strait of Hormuz. US envoy Brian Hegseth confirmed the ceasefire, following heightened tensions between Iran and the US. The situation remains fragile.

item.title: Iran-Israel war LIVE: Trump urges Iran to 'do the smart thing'
item.description: The UAE's air defenses are actively engaging with Iranian missiles and drones. The US has threatened a "devastating" response to any Iranian attack on shipping, as President Trump urged Iran to "do the smart thing" and avoid escalation.

item.title: Proposed UN resolution threatens Iran with sanctions if it doesn’t allow freedom of navigation
item.description: A proposed UN resolution threatens Iran with sanctions if it doesn't allow freedom of navigation. The resolution aims to pressure Iran into ensuring safe passage for ships in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway for global oil supplies.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Both Claim Control Over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US and Iran claim control over the Strait of Hormuz, with the US escorting ships and Iran intensifying control. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth hailed the new U. S. initiative to escort ships through the waterway, but traffic has not resumed.

item.title: Russian attacks kill at least 20 ahead of rival ceasefires proposed by Kyiv and Moscow
item.description: Russia and Ukraine announced rival ceasefires, with Ukraine pausing fighting sooner to pin violations on Moscow. Russia demanded a ceasefire on 8 and 9 May but Ukraine said it would pause the fighting sooner, meaning any violations would be pinned on Moscow.

item.title: West Bengal election win boosts Modi's BJP
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has won the West Bengal election, boosting its political dominance. The outcome is seen as a significant victory for Modi, allowing him to expand his party's influence in the region.

item.title: Hegseth says ceasefire is not over despite Iranian strikes on UAE and commercial vessels
item.description: Iranian strikes hit the UAE and commercial vessels, despite a claimed ceasefire, according to Hegseth. Live updates: Hegseth says ceasefire is not over despite Iranian strikes on UAE and commercial vessels AP News.

item.title: US affirms ceasefire with Iran is still in effect despite rising tensions in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US has affirmed that the ceasefire with Iran remains in effect, despite rising tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. The confirmation comes after recent attacks on ships and concerns about Iran's increasing military activities in the region.

item.title: Hegseth says US ‘hasn’t capitulated on anything’ regarding Iran
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated that the US has not capitulated on its demands from Iran. He made the comment in response to a reporter's query. US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told a reporter the US had not capitulated on its demands from Iran.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine announce rival ceasefires as deadly strikes continue
item.description: Russia and Ukraine announced rival ceasefires amid continued deadly strikes. The ceasefires were announced separately by both countries. Russia and Ukraine announce rival ceasefires as deadly strikes continue BBC.

item.title: Global South approach calls for three-part diplomacy
item.description: The Global South approach advocates for three-part diplomacy. This approach was discussed in a report by the Korea JoongAng Daily. Global South approach calls for three-part diplomacy Korea JoongAng Daily.

item.title: US-Iran ceasefire holds despite Hormuz standoff: Pentagon chief Hegseth
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said a ceasefire between the US and Iran holds despite a standoff in the Hormuz strait. The US has established a security 'dome' for ships.

item.title: India-UAE, India-U.S. among top 10 migration corridors in 2024: UN
item.description: India had several top migration corridors in 2024, including with the UAE and the US. Around 3.2 million Indian migrants lived in the US, the second-largest foreign-born group. The report said that around 3.2 million Indian migrants were living in the United States in 2024, the second largest foreign-born group after Mexicans.

item.title: Venice Biennale in crisis: The controversies explained
item.description: The Venice Biennale will not award the Golden Lion due to jury resignation over Russia and Israel's participation. The traditional Golden Lion will not be awarded this year, following the resignation of the jury over Russia's and Israel's disputed participation.

item.title: Why Europe’s car industry is at the centre of a new US trade war
item.description: The US may increase tariffs on EU cars and trucks to 25 percent, threatening Europe's car industry. Trump has threatened to increase tariffs on EU cars and trucks exported to the US from 15 percent to 25 percent.

item.title: US Warns Iran Of Forceful Response If Ships Attacked
item.description: US officials warned Iran of a forceful response if its ships are attacked, with Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth stressing that Washington is not seeking escalation. Hegseth made the comments without specifying what a forceful response might entail.

item.title: What Ghana’s foreign-built landmarks tell us about its global relationships
item.description: Ghana's foreign-built landmarks reveal its global relationships. The structures, built by countries like China and the US, demonstrate the nation's diplomatic and economic ties. What Ghana’s foreign-built landmarks tell us about its global relationships The Conversation.

item.title: Romania's pro-Europe government collapses after PM loses no-confidence vote
item.description: Romania's pro-European government collapsed after Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan lost a no-confidence vote, plunging the country into further political turmoil. The coalition government had been in power for a brief period.

item.title: U.S. ‘not looking for a fight’ over Strait of Hormuz, Pete Hegseth says
item.description: US officials said they are not looking for a fight over the Strait of Hormuz, with Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth stating that American forces will not need to enter Iranian waters or airspace to protect commercial shipping.

item.title: From an ‘American Dream School’ Education at Montclair to a Future in Policy and Global Studies
item.description: Montclair State University's American Dream School has helped students transition to careers in policy and global studies. The program's focus on real-world experience has been a key factor in its success.
